description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for uninstalling modules by deleting associated content entities. It includes methods for form rendering, access control, batch deletion of entities, and user confirmation.

classes.name: PrepareModulesEntityUninstallForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for confirming and executing the uninstallation of module content entities by deleting their data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form with the entity type manager service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with the container's entity type manager service.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Generates the confirmation question for deleting all entities of a type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a warning that the action cannot be undone.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the text for the confirmation button.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to cancel the operation and go back to module uninstall page.

methods.name: formTitle
methods.description: Sets the entity type ID and returns the confirmation question as the form title.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the entity type exists to allow access.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the confirmation form, including entity counts and recent entity labels.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Starts a batch process to delete all entities of the specified type.

methods.name: deleteContentEntities
methods.description: Batch callback to delete entities in chunks, updating progress.

methods.name: moduleBatchFinished
methods.description: Finalizes the batch, shows success message, and redirects to uninstall page.
